runtime_protocol.contracts: same-contract before/current; continuation requests both segment finals and one timed cat
runtime_protocol.integer_bitwise_checks: each segment output and each named final plus contract output/finals
runtime_protocol.supplied_initials: fixed-seed FP32 nonzero tensor values identical across variants

summary.measurement_basis: original timing round only; first pre-graph peak measurements; retry medians are gate-only

timing_protocol.gate_aggregation: median of original and two retry round median ratios, or original if no regression
timing_protocol.graphs: one fresh graph/pool live at a time; sequential variant order rotates across rounds; pool/results destroyed before next capture
timing_protocol.peak: clear both zero caches; discard results and graph pools; warm only measured variant; one call before any captures
timing_protocol.profile: CPU+CUDA CUPTI; _sleep(2000000) prime, sync before public call; preserve spin_kernel separately; retry partial counts <=3
timing_protocol.retry_when: any original timing metric after/before >1: two further full interleaved rounds

tolerances.bitwise: integer representation equality, all outputs and all named finals within same contract
